findings.note: NBA.com news from Nov 19, 2026 says Poeltl went back into the starting five against Washington after two bench games. In that start he had 8 points and 5 assists in 29 minutes, for 13 points plus assists, which clears 12.5.

RotoWire notes on CBS show his two starts with 31 minutes produced 21 (Nov 7 vs MIL) and 20 (Nov 10 vs MEM) points plus assists. They also show a left shoulder bursitis issue that cost him two games in early November and a minutes split with Murray-Boyles.

ESPN lists his 2026-27 averages at 8.1 points and 1.6 assists, about 9.7 combined, which is below the 12.5 line. NBA.com's game log shows he stayed under 12.5 in four of his last five games (4, 7, 12, 12, then 13).
